reason: I already have my suki nail tech on Messenger and she knows exactly what I like, even for the wedding. ₱1,800 is more than I pay at the mall, so I don't see why I'd switch to someone I've never tried.
objection: It costs more than the mall and I've never seen their work in person. I'm not going to risk my nails for a wedding on a new home-service artist with no reviews I know of.
would_change_my_mind: If my suki couldn't do my wedding date and they had a group rate for the whole entourage, around ₱1,200 each, plus real customer photos and reviews from brides in Cainta.
